title: Siddharth Traders v. Reena Shah
text: The complainant, Siddharth Traders, filed a complaint under Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act against the accused, Reena Shah, for dishonour of a cheque of Rs 4,25,000. The cheque was dishonoured due to 'Insufficient Funds'. A demand notice was sent by registered post. The accused filed a written reply to the demand notice denying liability but failed to pay. Before the court, the accused admitted her signature on the cheque but claimed it was a blank signed cheque given as security. The complainant produced account books and invoices establishing the debt. The defence of blank cheque given as security was not corroborated by any independent evidence. The presumption under Section 139 NI Act operates in favour of the complainant. The drawer, Reena Shah, is held guilty under Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act. Fine of Rs 8,50,000 imposed with one year imprisonment in default.
